fields.cause_of_loss_detail: Accidental - candle too close to combustibles
fields.cause_determination: Accidental - candle too close to combustibles
fields.narrative_summary: Engine and ladder companies responded to a reported structure fire at the above address. On arrival crews found smoke showing from the living room. Fire was contained to the area of origin and extinguished with one handline. Occupants were evacuated prior to arrival. Scene turned over to the owner after overhaul.
